name: touchline-matchday
description: Touchline Matchday — protótipo local da tela de partida

scripts.dev: npm run verify:onboarding-code && npm run ensure:onboarding-assets && vite --host 0.0.0.0 --open
scripts.build: npm run verify:onboarding-code && npm run ensure:onboarding-assets && vite build
scripts.verify:onboarding-code: node --check src/career-onboarding-offline.js && node --check src/onboarding/offline-data.js && node --check src/onboarding/offline-media.js && node --check src/onboarding/offline-view.js && node --check public/touchline-sw.js && node --check scripts/ensure-onboarding-pack.mjs && node --check tests/onboarding-offline-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node tests/ui-dom-smoke.mjs 1366 768 && node tests/ui-dom-smoke.mjs 1440 900
